articles.body:
The weekend of European soccer continues!

We kick things off in the Premier League, where four matches get underway simultaneously at 11 a.m. ET.

The spotlight will be on struggling Manchester United as they welcome AFC Bournemouth to Old Trafford, while Liverpool host high-flying Brighton & Hove Albion at Anfield. But Crystal Palace also take on Newcastle United and Hull City host Brentford.

Enjoy all the action from Sunday's matches across Europe.

articles.body:
Bayern Munich forward Lennart Karl is being tracked by Arsenal, Manchester United and Liverpool, while United defender Leny Yoro is on the radar of AC Milan. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Arsenal, Manchester United and Liverpool are monitoring Bayern Munich forward Lennart Karl, following concerns over his game time, according to TEAMtalk. Despite signing a new long-term deal earlier this year, the 18-year-old Germany international has made nine appearances this season -- scoring once and adding an assist -- and could consider an exit if his role does not expand.

- Manchester United defender Leny Yoro is on the radar of AC Milan ahead of the summer, says Calciomercato. Yoro, 20, has struggled since moving from Lille for €62 million in 2024, but former United boss Ruben Amorim is keen to bring him to San Siro to add depth to his defense. A fee of around €50 million is expected to be enough for the France international to move on.

- Trent Alexander-Arnold is not currently considered a concrete target for Liverpool as they evaluate future right-back options, reports Football Insider. Although the 28-year-old has experienced limited minutes at Real Madrid due to competition from Denzel Dumfries and Federico Valverde, there is no active movement toward an Anfield return.

- Tottenham Hotspur and Newcastle United have made inquiries regarding AC Milan duo Fikayo Tomori and Ruben Loftus-Cheek ahead of January, TEAMtalk reports. The Rossoneri are open to letting both players leave, with 28-year-old defender Tomori featuring just three times under Ruben Amorim and 30-year-old midfielder Loftus-Cheek making eight appearances across all competitions.

- Tottenham Hotspur will demand a hefty transfer fee for the transfer of right back Pedro Porro amid reported interest from Real Madrid and Barcelona, according to Diario AS. While the 27-year-old remains open to a LaLiga return despite extending his contract in the summer, Spurs have firmly ruled out a mid-season departure.

Other rumors

- Manchester City maintain an interest in Chelsea right back Malo Gusto, though the Blues have placed a £70 million valuation on the 23-year-old#s transfer for any potential reunion with Enzo Maresca. (TEAMtalk)

- Arsenal are preparing to hold contract extension talks with goalkeeper David Raya to commit his long-term future beyond 2028. (Football Insider)

- Liverpool and Real Madrid have joined the race to sign 19-year-old Brighton central defender Luka Vušković. (Football Insider)

- Juventus are monitoring Manchester City left back Rayan Aït-Nouri as the defender has had limited game time this season. (Ekrem Konur)

- Barcelona are planning to open contract extension talks with defender Gerard Martín to extend his deal beyond 2028.(Fabrizio Romano)

articles.description: Our experts dive into the odds and player props for Week 7 and offer their betting tips and favorite plays.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第7週ベッティングガイド：スプレッド、プロップ、タッチダウンの注目の賭け

articles.body:
Value is value, no matter where -- or how -- you find it. And that's what we'll aim to do each week in this space: find betting value.

Ben Solak, Seth Walder and Matt Bowen bring different perspectives into how they approach sports betting. Solak leans on his expertise in player evaluation and the X's and O's to find edges, while Walder relies on statistical models to pick out plus-expected value bets, focusing mainly on defense. Bowen, a former NFL safety, predicts positive matchups and game winners from tape study and his understanding of the league. Also included are fantasy projection creator Mike Clay's top predicted anytime TD scorers for Week 7.

From spreads and money lines to totals and defensive player props, a good price might be found anywhere. Results will be tracked throughout the season, with flat one-unit wagers for each listed bet. Let's get into it.

Note: Odds by DraftKings  and subject to change.

Heading into Week 7 of the NFL Sunday slate, I'm going to try some different things in this space. Yes, I'll still have some game picks in here that we need to hit on, but I'll also move around the league a little more. Spreads, totals, props, etc. -- with the same analysis based on the numbers and the game tape. Plus, I'll have more bets to play.

We'll start in Detroit, where I see two offenses with explosive-play ability -- playing indoors and on a really fast track -- pushing past the total.

Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

4:25 p.m. ET on Fox, Ford Field, Detroit

Total points OVER 53.5 (-110)

Let's see if the Lions made some defensive adjustments over the bye week (such as playing less man coverage). This unit has given up 29.6 points per game, and the Packers will have matchup advantages with Christian Watson and Matthew Golden. Plus, Josh Jacobs returns to the Green Bay backfield. While I do think the Packers defense has played really good football over the past three weeks (11.5 PPG), limiting Jared Goff, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs is a different test. The Lions are scoring 32.8 PPG for a reason. This has the makeup of a shootout in the controlled environment of Ford Field.

More bets to consider

Two-team, 6-point teaser: Vikings -0.5 vs. Colts, Broncos-Cardinals UNDER 49.5 (-143)

Getting the Vikings down to basically a moneyline play is a win. Brian Flores' defense is the story here, too. And with Daniel Jones' reduced mobility due to his Achilles injury in 2025, Flores can heat up the pocket.

articles.headline: Inside the silent messages Boye Mafe sends every game day
articles.description: The Bengals defensive end uses sign language to say "I love you" to his mother, Bola, who died of pancreatic cancer in 2018.
articles.headlineJa: ボイ・マフェが試合の日ごとに送る「静かなメッセージ」の中身
articles.descriptionJa: ベンガルスのディフェンシブエンドである彼は、2018年に膵臓がんで亡くなった母ボラに「愛してる」と伝えるため、手話を使っています。
articles.body:
CINCINNATI -- Before the chaos of each game unfolds, Cincinnati Bengals defensive end Boye Mafe has a conversation that centers him in a special place.

He closes his eyes and starts talking to his mother, Bola, who died of pancreatic cancer in 2018. And in those moments, Mafe lays out his vision for what's about to unfold.

I know you're watching over me. I want to put on a show for you. I love you and this is what I'm going to do for you.

Then he'll wrap up the message by using American Sign Language to say "I love you" before he continues the rest of his pregame routine. Mafe does the same after each sack.

But it's about more than signs. Everything Mafe does is about what he signals. From those messages to Bola, to his pregame outfits, to how he plays, it's all about honoring the systems and structures that built him into one of the NFL's leading pass rushers and a Super Bowl champion.

"I try not to let circumstances dictate who I am," Mafe told ESPN. "At the end of the day, I am who I am and I want to be true to who I am."

That doesn't come easily. Mafe, the son of proud Nigerians, grapples with a phenomenon that is common among those with generational ties to other places -- the more time passes, the harder it is to stay connected to those roots.

But all it takes is one glance on game day to see just how strong those ties are.

How Boye Mafe's mother impacted her community

To fully understand why Mafe signs to his late mother requires understanding his upbringing in the western suburbs of Minneapolis.

Mafe and his siblings often communicate via American Sign Language. Starting with his older sister, Tayo, they all decided to study it in high school as their alternative language. And over the years the practice has stuck, even during games. Once, Tayo recalled signing to Mafe when he suffered an injury at Minnesota. He quickly signaled back that it wasn't anything serious.

Of all Mafe's six siblings, he is the one who spent the most time in their mother's seamstress shop on 1110 Lowery Avenue in North Minneapolis. There, Bola did more than mend clothes. She served as a cultural hub for many, not just Nigerians or those with Yoruba roots.

And she invested in the community. She volunteered at a battered women's shelter, made vests for Mafe's entire church choir and often let her customers have some extended credit.

"She had a lot of patience because sometimes people couldn't pay and she was like, 'Oh, pay me later,'" said Angie Onayiga, one of Bola's longtime friends. "She still gave them the clothes, sold things for them."

When Bola was diagnosed with cancer while Boye was in high school, the bond between mother and son deepened. Boye and his brother Domi did everything they could to make sure Bola was as comfortable as possible as the disease progressed.

How she fought the disease made a lasting impact on Boye.

articles.headline: Julián Álvarez apologizes to Atlético Madrid fans over bid to join Barcelona
articles.description: Julián Álvarez apologized to Atlético Madrid fans for attempting to force a departure from the club in the summer after ending his LaLiga goal drought.
articles.headlineJa: ジュリアン・アルバレス、バルセロナ移籍を画策したことでアトレティコ・マドリードのファンに謝罪
articles.descriptionJa: ジュリアン・アルバレスは、ラ・リーガでの得点空白期間を脱した後の夏に、クラブからの強引な移籍を試みたことについて、アトレティコ・マドリードのファンに謝罪しました。
articles.body:
MADRID -- Julián Álvarez apologized to Atlético Madrid fans for attempting to force a departure from the club in the summer, after scoring in the team's 1-0 LaLiga win over Deportivo A Coruña on Saturday.

Álvarez's crucial 48th minute goal gave Atlético a valuable victory, which left them just two points behind leaders Barcelona ahead of Sunday's Clásico at Camp Nou.

- It's time for El Clásico! All you need to know about Barça vs. Madrid

- Barça outline plan to stop Mbappé in Clásico

- José Mourinho: 'Real Madrid with Mourinho wins trophies'

The Argentina forward said he wanted to leave Atlético during the World Cup, with Barcelona his preferred destination, and belatedly apologized for his handling of the situation on Saturday, having scored twice in four days, ending a six-month goal drought.

"I want to apologize to our fans for my words during the World Cup," Álvarez told Movistar. "It was a mistake in terms of how I expressed myself and the timing.

"I understand the fans [anger] especially given how they've supported me since I arrived. They have been very generous toward me. Now it's time for me to get to work and give everything I've got."

Álvarez's bid to join Barça was followed by an injury-hit, difficult start to the season, and he has frequently been whistled and booed by Atlético fans at the Metropolitano.

Saturday's goal was Álvarez's first in LaLiga for eight months and first league goal in front of Atlético's home fans since November 2025.

"I'm feeling better and better," he said. "I've always had support. I'm working on improving. I'm feeling better physically ... When you feel good in life, it shows on the pitch. Even though we are professionals, everything has an impact."

While many fans applauded Álvarez's goal on Saturday, some continued to voice their disapproval.

"I have a great deal of respect for people who apologize, because apologizing is not easy," coach Diego Simeone said. "I'm very happy for [Álvarez], he must feel a great sense of peace.

"When someone says something like that, it's because they truly mean it. As for the player, I'm absolutely delighted ... We need him.

"If the club wants to reach the heights the fans dream of, we need Julián Álvarez to be at his best."

articles.headline: Álvarez's 1st LaLiga home goal in 11 months sees Atlético  close gap to Barça
articles.description: Julián Álvarez scored his first LaLiga goal in eight months as Atlético Madrid beat Deportivo 1-0 to climb to within two points of leaders Barcelona.
articles.headlineJa: アルバレスが11ヶ月ぶりのラ・リーガ・ホームゴールを記録、アトレティコがバルサとの差を縮める
articles.descriptionJa: ジュリアン・アルバレスが8ヶ月ぶりのラ・リーガでのゴールを決め、アトレティコ・マドリードがデポルティーボに1-0で勝利。首位バルセロナとの勝ち点差を2に縮めた。
articles.body:
Julián Álvarez scored his first LaLiga goal in eight months as Atlético Madrid beat Deportivo 1-0 to climb to within two points of leaders Barcelona.

Álvarez, who was involved in a contentious transfer saga involving Barcelona this summer, scored the game's only goal early in the second half. The Argentina forward was making his first league start of the season and his goal was his first in front of Atlético's home fans in the league since November 2025. 

The goal was enough as Atlético extended their unbeaten run to eight matches before Barca take on Real Madrid at Camp Nou in Sunday's Clásico.

Atlético's six-game winning run in all competitions was halted in Tuesday's 1-1 Champions League draw in Stuttgart and they came under early pressure against Deportivo.

Visiting defender Miguel Loureiro's header was saved by Atlético goalkeeper Jan Oblak, who pulled off two more in quick succession midway through the first half to keep out Yeremay Hernández's long-range effort and Lorenzo Amatucci's follow-up.

Atlético stirred themselves as half-time approached, but they failed to trouble Depor goalkeeper Leo Román as shots from Lee Kang-In, Pablo Barrios and Morten Hjulmand were all off target.

Atlético boss Diego Simeone sent on son Giuliano Simeone and Robin Le Normand in place of Barrios and Ademola Lookman at the start of the second half and the changes had an immediate impact.

Alejandro Grimaldo provided the cross and Álvarez converted from close range to make it two goals in as many matches having scored the equaliser at Stuttgart in midweek.

Atlético stepped it up in pursuit of a second. Álex Baena's effort from outside the box was saved by Roman and the Spain midfielder had another shot blocked before Dávid Hancko and Simeone fired high and wide.

The home side continued to threaten, but Álvarez and Simeone were thwarted by Román before Depor went close to snatching a point through Kevin Sanchez's stoppage-time shot, which was superbly saved by Oblak.

PA contributed to this report.

articles.body:
EAGAN, Minn. -- The Minnesota Vikings activated running back Jordan Mason from injured reserve Saturday, completing his recovery from a fractured thumb that required surgery last month.

The Vikings had already created a spot for Mason on the 53-man roster Friday by releasing running back DeeJay Dallas, who re-signed Saturday to the Vikings' practice squad and was elevated to the game-day roster for Sunday's matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

Mason is expected to split time against the Indianapolis Colts with teammate Aaron Jones Sr., who took 90% of the Vikings' running back carries in Mason's absence.

"Getting Jordan back, I think, will be a really positive thing, just because of the offseason he had and the excitement," coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday after Mason completed a week of practice with no setbacks. "My excitement to see him paired with Aaron, and how we go about the usage there, is going to be an exciting thing because we feel so confident in both of them. But with the workload Aaron's had and the type of warrior he's been, it'll be good to have JP back."

In his only appearance this season, Mason carried 15 times for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 39-22 victory over the Green Bay Packers. He reported thumb soreness the following day, leading to the discovery of a small fracture.

In his second season with the Vikings, Mason has rushed for 2,070 yards and 14 touchdowns since joining the San Francisco 49ers in 2022.

articles.headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks out vs. Cowboys
articles.description: The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys.
articles.headlineJa: イーグルスのデヴォンタ・スミスとドンタイビオン・ウィックス、カウボーイズ戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: イーグルスのトップレシーバーであるデヴォンタ・スミスとドンタイビオン・ウィックスの2名が、月曜夜のカウボーイズ戦を欠場することが決定した。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Dallas Cowboys.

Smith has been dealing with hamstring issues since the summer, when he was sidelined for a portion of training camp.

He tweaked his hamstring Week 2 against the Tennessee Titans, saying recently that he thought being dehydrated in the Nashville heat was a contributing factor. He played through the injury the following week but missed the next two games before returning last Sunday against the Carolina Panthers, catching seven balls for 75 yards and a touchdown. Smith was unable to practice this week.

Wicks appeared on the practice report this week with an ankle injury. This will be the first time he'll miss a game with the Eagles.

Tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) expects to play despite missing the first two days of practice this week. The Eagles' offense could also welcome back Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and lineman Landon Dickerson (knee/pec), both of whom are questionable.

Nolan Smith (concussion) has been ruled out, while fellow edge rusher Jonathan Greenard (ankle) is questionable, telling reporters Friday that he is a game-time decision.

articles.headline: Packers activate RB Josh Jacobs for 2026 debut
articles.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut against the Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.
articles.headlineJa: パッカーズ、RBジョシュ・ジェイコブスをアクティブにし2026年シーズン初出場へ
articles.descriptionJa: パッカーズのランニングバック、ジョシュ・ジェイコブスは、NFLコミッショナー免除リストに6週間入っていた後、ライオンズ戦で2026年シーズン初出場を果たす。
articles.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut Sunday against the Detroit Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

Green Bay added him to the active roster from exempt status Saturday. The NFL took Jacobs off the exempt list Monday.

The NFL's investigation of Jacobs for potential violations of the personal conduct policy following his arrest earlier this year on misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor destruction of property charges remains active, and a suspension could be equal to or greater than the number of games he already missed. The six games he has missed would be credited toward any suspension.

For now, Jacobs is cleared to play. 

Jacobs pleaded no contest Sept. 10 to the charges resulting from the May 23 incident with a woman at his home near Green Bay. He was convicted of battery and fined $1,000 and reached a deferred judgment agreement on the property damage charge.

Without Jacobs, the Packers have had the worst running game in the NFL, ranking last in rushing yards per game at 59.8 yards. Jacobs was the Packers' leading rusher the previous two seasons, ranking eighth in the league in combined rushing yards (2,258) and tied for fourth in rushing touchdowns (28) during the 2024 and 2025 seasons.

The Packers also signed WR/KR Coleman Owen to the active roster off the practice squad, elevated edge rusher Arron Mosby from the practice squad for game day, and activated defensive tackle Jordon Riley off the physically unable to perform list.
